    <h1>DC Dark Legion reports</h1>

<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
These are on the same **📊 Reports** panel as the core reports (see [**Reports**](/guides/reports/)), in a server with DC Dark Legion switched on.

Open to everyone:

- **🏙️ Gotham season**: who attended the season's Battle for Gotham and its Ultimates, and who holds a box.
- **⚡ AKR season**: the season's Krypton Rush events and who attended how many. Officers also award AKR boxes here (see [**Seasons and Red Boxes**](/guides/seasons-and-red-boxes/)).
- **🎁 Red Box history**: every player's boxes, most recent first.

Rotation reports (need **See rotation reports**, seniors and officers by default):

- **🚂 Train pool by seat**: who is eligible this week, the Conductor group, who is kept off carriages, and each carriage's seat preferences.
- **🎟️ Not on the train yet**: who is still waiting for a turn this cycle.
- **🕐 Last train ride**: when each player last rode, oldest first.
- **🛡️ Guardian pool**, **🏙️ No Guardian post yet** and **🕐 Last Guardian post**: the same for Guardian.

Every report has **◀ Back** to the panel.
{% endraw %}
